text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Classic Triple Crown right before 
her, Hishi Miracle's fighting spirit was 
still nowhere to be found. And so, her 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You decide to have her train at the same 
time as her formidable classmate, the God 
of Destruction Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, rather than engaging in any real 
rivalry, she instead listened to Tanino 
Gimlet's extraordinarily grueling plans 
for the future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Completely weirded out, she backed away. 
The plan to stoke her fighting spirit 
ended in failure.
